title: My Crush's Crush Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, Staff, April Debut
content: The official website for the anime of writer Sekina Aoi and artist Ryō Tsuzura 's My Crush’s Crush ( Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ) manga presented the anime's teaser promotional video and teaser visual on Monday. The video announces the anime's main cast, staff, and April 2027 premiere.
author: ANN

title: After 5 Years, Black Clover Season 2 Finally Debuts Noelle’s Strongest Form
content: Black Clover Season 2 is working its way through some of the biggest fights of the anime to date, and the newest episode has finally debuted Noelle Silva’s strongest form after five years of fans waiting to see it in action.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
content: Production company Avex Pictures opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Sekina Aoi and Ryou Tsuzura 's Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ( My Crush's Crush ) manga on Friday, revealing the main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Spy x Family' Gets Season 4, Second Anime Movie in 2027
content: • The Spy x Family Anime Extra Mission II special event announced a fourth season and a second theatrical movie on Sunday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured) for Season 4 . The new season and movie are scheduled for a 2027 premiere.
author: MyAnimeList

title: SPY x FAMILY Season 4 and Movie Announced in 2027
content: SPY x FAMILY Season 4 and a movie has been announced and is slated to premiere in 2027. title: Spy x Family Confirms Season 4 Return & New Movie in 2027 (First Look Revealed)
content: It’s official, Spy x Family has confirmed the anime is making a huge return next year with both Season 4 of the TV series and a new movie on the way. Tatsuya Endo’s Spy x Family has been a massive success ever since the manga made its original debut in 2019, and the franchise has absolutely exploded in popularity…

title: Bride of the Barrier Master Anime Streams Videos for Leads Hana Ichise, Saku Ichinomiya
content: The staff for the television anime of Kureha 's Bride of the Barrier Master ( Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ) light novel series started streaming the character promotional videos for Hana Ichise and Saku Ichinomiya on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Minami-ke Season 5 Reveals Teaser Visual, Trailer, April 2027 Premiere
content: The previously announced Minami-ke Season 5 revealed a teaser visual and trailer along with an April 2027 premiere date. Studio LIDENFILMS is animating. Junichi Kitamura is directing the anime with Takamitsu Kono in charge of the series composition.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Minami-ke Korekara' Reveals New Staff, Teaser Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
content: • The Minami-ke Special Event 2026 revealed new staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video for the Season 5 on Sunday. The fifth season adapting Coharu Sakuraba 's comedy slice of life manga will premiere in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Minami-ke Korekara TV Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, Staff, April Debut
content: The " Minami-ke Special Event 2026" debuted the teaser promotional video, teaser visual, and character visuals for Minami-ke: Korekara ( Minami-ke : Going Forward), the new sequel television anime series based on Coharu Sakuraba 's Minami-ke manga , on Sunday.
author: ANN
